---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for this project
labels: enhancement, feature, triage
---

## Describe the feature

A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## Motivation and use case

Explain why this feature is needed, what problem it solves, or what value it adds. Describe the use case(s) it addresses.

**Educational Context**: How would this feature enhance the learning experience for Node.js developers using this tutorial application?

## Proposed solution or implementation (optional)

If you have ideas for how this could be implemented, describe them here. Consider the educational objectives of this project and how your solution would maintain code clarity and learning value. (Optional)

## Acceptance criteria / Definition of done

List specific criteria that must be met for this feature to be considered complete:

- [ ] Feature implements the described functionality
- [ ] Code follows the project's style guidelines (ESLint passes)
- [ ] Comprehensive test coverage (90%+ required)
- [ ] Documentation updated (inline comments, README.md if needed)
- [ ] Educational value clearly demonstrated
- [ ] All existing tests continue to pass

## Alternatives considered or related features

Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered, or reference related issues/PRs.

## Additional context

Add any other context, references, or screenshots about the feature request here.

**Educational Impact**: Please describe how this feature would contribute to the educational goals of demonstrating Node.js, Express.js, and modern web development concepts.

---

### Before submitting this feature request:

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have considered how this feature aligns with the educational objectives of this tutorial project
- [ ] I understand that this is an educational project focused on Node.js fundamentals
